description: Partial source-and-runtime review. A local instance is not organism-wide theorem coverage.

declarations.name: CGB.ActiveInference.action_condition_required
declarations.premise: world must respond differently to actions and prediction must use resulting self-conditioned state

declarations.name: CGB.ActiveInference.active_closure
declarations.premise: unbounded usable signal, bounded signal for every eventually passive policy, and action-sensitive response

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.ActiveNavigation.reactivation_exact_held
declarations.premise: fixed detached source, fixed query weight, a=1; value-path derivative with current encoder only

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.ActiveNavigation.reactivation_superposition
declarations.premise: fixed raw source features and fixed mixing weights; excludes weight derivative and original GDN parameter drift

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.ActiveNavigation.reactivation_partial_bias
declarations.premise: fixed linear superposition; retained and omitted contributions must be explicitly identifiable
declarations.v2_code: scripts/ib_local/latent_navigation_v2.py:merge and eviction obscure individual omitted terms

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.exact_key_capacity
declarations.premise: linear independent keys in finite d-dimensional vector space; not capacity of all mixed associations

declarations.name: CGB.ClosedLoopCredit.objective_deriv_advantage
declarations.premise: old action bridge only: complete action record, fixed conditional world kernel and direct-score derivative
declarations.new_code: scripts/ib_local/latent_navigation.py; not connected to action trainer
declarations.v2_code: scripts/ib_local/latent_navigation.py; not connected to action trainer

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.tiedWrite_eq_delta_add
declarations.premise: one-hot keyed value; frozen current row; beta as declared

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.tied_write_is_error_descent
declarations.premise: one-hot keyed local squared error; not full language objective

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.tied_write_error_shrinks
declarations.premise: unit one-hot key, local write; new endpoint beta=1, raw stored coordinate

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.tied_write_cross_read
declarations.premise: raw value-row update, fixed linear query and fixed encoder; excludes key/softmax changes

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.exact_prediction_no_write
declarations.premise: only the value coordinate when incoming value equals stored value; replacement can still change the key

declarations.name: CGB.CountedPopulation.tag_is_exact_credit
declarations.premise: tag follows specified nonnegative linear counted-population transport and fixed bets

declarations.name: CGB.InformationEnergy.mixture_regret_le
declarations.premise: Bayesian mixture over fixed hypothesis sequence likelihoods, not same-batch learning progress

declarations.name: CGB.Generation.gated_delta_contracts
declarations.premise: alpha times deltaStep, not assumed for decay_then_delta runtime
